Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":16,"var":"data/size","code":"buf.data = (UA_Byte*)data; buf.length = size;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as a JSON byte string and passed into the decoder.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":25,"var":"out","code":"UA_decodeJson(&buf, &out, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_VARIANT]);","note":"The fuzzer decodes the input as a Variant, so any malformed nested JSON can drive the generic JSON decoder and its cleanup paths.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buf"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"UA_decodeJson","line":null,"var":"dst","code":"dispatches to the type-specific JSON decoder for UA_TYPES_VARIANT","note":"The generic decoder routes the input through Variant decoding, which can allocate nested heap objects while parsing attacker-controlled JSON.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"decode target type"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson","line":2753,"var":"dst->value","code":"{UA_JSONKEY_VALUE, &dst->value, (decodeJsonSignature) Variant_decodeJson, false, NULL}","note":"Variant decoding can recurse into nested values and create heap-backed members that later need precise ownership handling.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"variant contents"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"Variant_clear","line":415,"var":"p->data","code":"if(p->type && p->data > UA_EMPTY_ARRAY_SENTINEL) { ... UA_Array_delete(p->data, p->arrayLength, p->type); p->data = NULL; }","note":"Cleanup frees the Variant payload based on its runtime type and length, so any stale alias to the freed payload becomes dangerous.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"control","via":"cleanup after decode"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"LocalizedText_clear","line":796,"var":"p->locale / p->text","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"LocalizedText cleanup is one of the nested clear routines reached from Variant deletion and can free string members embedded in decoded values.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"control","via":"nested clear"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"UA_clear","line":977,"var":"dst","code":"UA_clear(dst, type);","note":"The generic clear dispatcher invokes the type-specific clear function for the decoded object graph, releasing heap storage owned by the Variant.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"control","via":"dispatcher"}]},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"UA_clear","line":977,"var":"dst","code":"UA_clear(dst, type);","note":"If the decoded object graph contains an internal alias or double-owned member, the clear path can free it while another reference still exists.","depends_on":[{"on":7,"type":"data","via":"freed object graph"}]},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"Variant_clear","line":415,"var":"p->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(p->data, p->arrayLength, p->type);","note":"The root cause hypothesis is that JSON decoding can leave a Variant with ownership metadata that causes later cleanup to free memory still reachable through another nested reference.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"data","via":"ownership mismatch"}]},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"LocalizedText_clear","line":796,"var":"p->text","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"A subsequent clear of a nested LocalizedText/String member can then read from or free the already-released heap region, producing the reported use-after-free sink.","depends_on":[{"on":9,"type":"data","via":"dangling nested member"}]}]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc1.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 1.
